title: Zala
tagline: A dapp which lets users create goals and invest for those goals
description:
A dapp which lets users create goals and invest for those goals. The plan is to let users stake Ether and gain interest with Compound or any other deFi protocol. In future we plan to integrate with Signer protocol for each goal user stakes for.
